messages:
Maria: Heads-up — since last night we're seeing ~0.8% of streaming chat sessions drop mid-response (backend still generating) across eu-west and us-west. Correlated with WAF ruleset v3.14 rollout and a GPU autoscale event at 23:40 UTC.
Sam: Logs?
Maria: Envoy on edge shows a pattern: `HTTP/2 RST_STREAM` and `GOAWAY` while backend continues to stream. Example:
```
[2026-03-17T23:42:01Z] envoy error: h2 error code=RST_STREAM stream_id=87 reason=STREAM_CLOSED
[2026-03-17T23:42:01Z] envoy info: sent GOAWAY last_stream_id=90 debug="admin: draining"
```
Li: Also saw WAF (modsec) logs showing body buffering + chunked parsing spikes around same time. It holds the request until inspection completes.
Sam: That buffering + h2 window interplay can cause the edge to exceed flow-control window and reset streams. Any kernel/network signals?
Maria: During GPU scale-up we also saw NAT ephemeral port exhaustion on some egress nodes. `ss -s` snapshot:
```
TCP:   12345 total (1230 established, 9000 TIME_WAIT, ...)
```
Maria: TIME_WAIT spike lines up with node churn (pods rescheduled), leading to conn reuse/plumbing oddities.
Jonathan: So two contributing factors: WAF buffering increases per-connection memory/latency -> h2 flow control pressure, and ephemeral port pressure during scale events -> resets. Makes sense.
Sam: Quick test: disabling request-body inspection for /v1/stream reduces buffering. Can we canary that?
Maria: Canaried edge policy 10:15 UTC -> error rate dropped from 0.8% -> 0.05% on canary region.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1234 (streaming-edge-waf-nat). Assigned to @Sam.
Sam: Plan: 1) rollback modsec inspect rule for streaming routes 2) increase SNAT port pool on egress nodes + enable ephemeral port reuse tuning 3) add h2 keepalive/flow-control hints on proxy side 4) long-term: passthrough mode for streaming clients.
Li: Repro steps I used:
```
# reproduce from testbed
stress-client --streams 100 --payload 512k /v1/stream
# observe envoy RSTs when modsec enabled
```
Maria: Workaround applied to prod: disable body-inspect for /v1/stream + restart edge config (rolled 5% -> 100% over 30m). Metrics normalized.
Sam: I'll follow up with a postmortem and a PR for kube-proxy SNAT config; will also file an infra ticket to reserve NAT pools during GPU scaleups.
Jonathan: Add note to release cadence: avoid major WAF rule rollouts during GPU scale events if possible.
Maria: Thanks all. Leaving logs in #eng-infra artifacts: s3://redwood-ops/inc/INC-2026-1234.tar.gz :thumbsup: 
Sam: assigning to me and @Li to drive the fix. :+1:
